fair_value.method: Blend of a FCFF DCF (55% weight, $28: WACC 11%, revenue $2.8bn FY27 -> ~$14bn FY29-32, 70-72% EBITDA margin, $27.5bn FY27 capex then ~$4.7bn/yr maintenance, 2% terminal growth, + $2.1bn powered-land pipeline, rolled forward at 15.3% CoE) and 7.5x NTM EV/EBITDA at Oct-2027 (45%, $56: $6.0bn EBITDA, $14.5bn net debt, 575M shares). The DCF is low because the build-out earns only ~10% ROIC vs 11% WACC; the multiple credits the contracted ramp.

reasoning: Basic facts from filings: FY26 revenue $707m, adj. EBITDA $246m, $1bn ARR operating, >$4bn contracted ARR for 2026 capacity (~0.3GW), ~0.8GW targeted by end-2027, FY27 capex guidance $25-30bn, 394M shares, roughly net cash after restricted cash but $6.3bn of convertibles. In-lane work: SemiAnalysis' ClusterMAX 3.0 (Sep 2026) rates IREN 'Underperforming' (outages in BC, ~129GB/s busBW vs >=300 for top tier), a sell-side-adjacent signal that limits the multiple and enterprise wins; GPU rental trackers show H100 neo-cloud pricing firm ($2.77/hr Silicon Data, Oct 1; BofA spot +33% y/y) and B200 ~$5.6-6.4/hr, which supports mgmt's $20-25M/MW contract pricing and renewal assumptions; job-posting data (16 simultaneous roles in Apr 2026, 84-144 open Glassdoor roles) is consistent with a real operational build-out; Substack analysts converge on the core problem, capital intensity of $40-50bn/GW and ~50% dilution per GW even with 80% financing; Stocktwits mentions are cooling (-22% vs 3 months) while sentiment stays bullish, i.e. no capitulation; short interest ~24%. Powered-land comps (MARA ~$0.3M/MW) value the unbuilt pipeline at only ~$2bn. Reddit (blocked, HTML wall) and X posts (HTTP 402) could not be read; X items are cited as leads only, not used for numbers. No prediction markets exist on IREN. Valuation: a capex-honest DCF gives ~$28 at the 12-month mark because new capacity earns ~10% ROIC vs an 11% WACC (10Y 5.29%); a 7.5x forward EV/EBITDA gives ~$56; blend $40.8, almost exactly spot and the Redburn $40 target, below the ~$78 street mean. So I centre the 12-month distribution a little below spot (median ~$39; scenario mean ~$45) with very wide dispersion (lognormal sigma ~0.75, a bit under 107% realized because the contracted ARR ramp adds some visibility), fat left tail for funding risk and a right tail to $80-100 if the 2027 build lands. 1-month: no scheduled event in window, so near-symmetric.
